name: Aura/Tint HealthColors
description: Script to set health indicator on tokens via aura or tint, based on a bars value. Be sure to set the bar your health is tied to in the menu: API menu command !AURA

useroptions.name: auraColorOn
useroptions.description: Master switch: colour tokens by health. Default: enabled.

useroptions.name: auraBar
useroptions.description: Token bar that holds hit points. Default: bar1.

useroptions.name: auraTint
useroptions.description: Colour the token tint instead of the Aura 1 ring. Default: disabled (aura mode).

useroptions.name: colorPalette
useroptions.description: Health colour palette. default = green/yellow/red; colorblind = cyan/orange/magenta. Default: default.

useroptions.name: auraPercPC
useroptions.description: HP % at or below which player-character tokens show their health colour. 0 disables, 100 always shows. Default: 100.

useroptions.name: auraPerc
useroptions.description: HP % at or below which NPC tokens show their health colour. 0 disables, 100 always shows. Default: 100.

useroptions.name: PCAura
useroptions.description: Track health on player-character tokens. Default: enabled.

useroptions.name: NPCAura
useroptions.description: Track health on NPC tokens. Default: enabled.

useroptions.name: auraDeadPC
useroptions.description: Apply the dead (Red X) status marker to player characters at 0 HP. Default: enabled.

useroptions.name: auraDead
useroptions.description: Apply the dead (Red X) status marker to NPCs at 0 HP. Default: enabled.

useroptions.name: GM_PCNames
useroptions.description: GM visibility of player-character nameplates. Yes = always show, No = always hide, Off = leave Roll20's setting. Default: Yes.

useroptions.name: GM_NPCNames
useroptions.description: GM visibility of NPC nameplates. Yes = always show, No = always hide, Off = leave Roll20's setting. Default: Yes.

useroptions.name: PCNames
useroptions.description: Player visibility of player-character nameplates. Yes = always show, No = always hide, Off = leave Roll20's setting. Default: Yes.

useroptions.name: NPCNames
useroptions.description: Player visibility of NPC nameplates. Yes = always show, No = always hide, Off = leave Roll20's setting. Default: Yes.

useroptions.name: AuraSize
useroptions.description: Aura 1 health-ring radius in feet beyond the token edge (aura mode). Default: 0.35.

useroptions.name: Aura1Shape
useroptions.description: Aura 1 shape shown in the settings output. Default: Circle.

useroptions.name: Aura1Color
useroptions.description: Aura 1 display colour shown in the settings output, as a 6-digit hex value without #. Default: 00FF00.

useroptions.name: Aura2Size
useroptions.description: Aura 2 radius shown in the settings output. Default: 5.

useroptions.name: Aura2Shape
useroptions.description: Aura 2 shape shown in the settings output. Default: Square.

useroptions.name: Aura2Color
useroptions.description: Aura 2 display colour shown in the settings output, as a 6-digit hex value without #. Default: 806600.

useroptions.name: OneOff
useroptions.description: Also track tokens that are not linked to a character sheet. Default: disabled.

useroptions.name: FX
useroptions.description: Play particle effects when a token is hurt or healed. Default: enabled.

useroptions.name: HealFX
useroptions.description: Healing effect: a 6-digit hex colour (recolours the default burst), a Roll20 built-in effect such as glow-holy, or a custom FX name. Default: FDDC5C.

useroptions.name: HurtFX
useroptions.description: Damage effect: a 6-digit hex colour (recolours the default burst), a Roll20 built-in effect such as explode-blood, or a custom FX name. Default: FF0000.

useroptions.name: auraDeadFX
useroptions.description: Jukebox track to play when a token dies (comma-separate several to pick at random), or None. Default: None.

useroptions.name: deathSavesOn
useroptions.description: Enable Death Save Integration: distinguish dying / stable / dead player characters at 0 HP from watched death-save fields. Beacon (D&D 2024) sheets need Mod Script Sandbox v1.5. Default: disabled.

useroptions.name: dsSuccessAttr
useroptions.description: Death-save success field name(s), comma-separated for checkbox sheets. Default: deathsave_succ1,deathsave_succ2,deathsave_succ3.

useroptions.name: dsFailureAttr
useroptions.description: Death-save failure field name(s), comma-separated for checkbox sheets. Default: deathsave_fail1,deathsave_fail2,deathsave_fail3.

useroptions.name: dsDyingMarker
useroptions.description: Status marker for a dying player character at 0 HP. Use the exact tag from !aura deathsaves markers for custom markers. Default: skull.

useroptions.name: dsStableMarker
useroptions.description: Status marker for a stable player character (3 death-save successes). Default: green.
